title: Search for who pays creators, not for creators
hypothesis: Title keywords like creator, athlete and ambassador find the brand person who signs creators.
change: Swapped to buyer keywords (influencer marketing, partnership, creator marketing, social, brand, community or marketing manager) and excluded ambassador, athlete, content creator and model.

oracle.baseline: creator keywords: 0 of 5 Gymshark hits were buyers

result: With creator keywords all 5 Gymshark hits were people the brand pays. With buyer keywords Gymshark, Celsius and Barebells each gave an influencer or partnerships buyer.
next_decision: Keep buyer keywords as the default for brand-side searches; measure buyer hit rate over 20 brands before calling it confirmed.
check: When the target is the person who pays a type of people, search the payer's titles and exclude the paid people's titles.
scope: Fitness and beverage brands, Clay people search, October 2026.
